H1.rule: ShT micro(obj+grid_T2) - micro(obj+grid_T0) > 0 and 95% CI lower bound > 0

H2.rule: ShT micro(obj+grid_T2) - micro(obj): weak CI upper >= 0, strong CI lower > 0

H3a.rule: ShT single-channel macro |delta| < 0.005 in every arm (else an implementation error)

H3b.rule: ShT Fd alone micro T2 - T0: 95% CI lower bound > 0

H3c.rule: prediction: ShT I alone micro |T2 - T0| < 0.02

H4_checks.rule: descriptive (TASLAK §3.6): single-channel micro and macro |delta T1-T0| < 0.005; Ped1 grid gain over obj (T1) CI lower bound > 0

decision.rule: T2 becomes the grid calibrator only if H1 and H4 both hold; otherwise T0 stays and stage 1 is reported as a negative result
